purpose: Present an action as the only available choice.
keywords: Verb dictionary form + しかない
There are no more trains, so we have no choice but to walk.
Having come this far, we just have to do it.
We can only wait until a reply comes.
formation: Verb dictionary form + しかない
restrictions: Often implies resignation, but can also express determination.
mistake: Use the dictionary form: 待つしかない, not 待たないしかない.
